what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 4 of 4: The ray limit of the clocked walk as a theorem, with its first correction. SETTING (blocks 53 and 54; open PRs titled 'ail53: no master clock' and 'ail54: a phase timed by the local clock'; both are SUPPLIED clauses, not adopted; the axioms memo docs/MINIMAL_AXIOMS_2026-06-29.md defines no time metric and no amplitude dynamics). BLOCK 53: every site of Z^3 has a positive tick rate w_x, u = log w; the rate at a site is determined by its six neighbours' rates by one rule, covariant under translations and proper rotations, and scale covariant (only ratios of rates mean anything). ESTABLISHED there: every such rule has the weak-field form u_x = average of u over the six neighbours (no mass term); on a torus only the zero-sum part of a source enters; a record enters as a ratio kappa of its rate to its neighbours' mean, that is as the additive source log kappa (exact superposition; clocks slow near records if kappa < 1); ONE NUMBER, kappa, is left, and the second order of the rule is not fixed ((p - 1) d^2/6 for the power mean of order p). BLOCK 54: one moving record is a two-component amplitude psi_x (the site's qubit as its content; rotations turn the content as a direction); hermitian, rotation-covariant nearest-neighbour generators have the symbol a_0 + 2a sum cos k_j + beta sum sigma_j sin k_j; the walk with the qubit as coin is H = sum_j sigma_j D_j, D_j = (i/2)(T_j - T_j^dagger), energies +-sqrt(sum sin^2 k_j), velocity operator sigma_j (T_j + T_j^dagger)/2, and NO 2x2 matrix anticommutes with it (one walker has no rest energy). CLAUSE: the amplitude at a site advances in that site's own time, giving the generator w H, similar to the hermitian H_w = sqrt(w) H sqrt(w), conserved sum |psi_x|^2/w_x. ESTABLISHED: in a uniform gradient H_w^n T_a = lambda_a^n T_a H_w^n exactly (force = -(energy) x grad u in every state); rays of E = w(x) eps(k) obey dv_j/dt = -w^2 sum_l d_j d_l(eps^2/2) d_l u + 2 (v.grad u) v_j, which for the walk is -w^2 cos(2 k_j) d_j u + 2 (v.grad u) v_j whatever the rest energy; EXECUTED, NOT PROVED: packets follow clouds of rays to 5 parts in 10^4 (line) and 2 parts in 10^3 (three dimensions), and they also drift SIDEWAYS along (gradient) x (motion) by g T/(2k) (measured -0.119 and -0.227 against 0.120 and 0.240), which no ray has. Controls: .claude/science/physics-loops/admissibility-induced-law-20260906/specs/supervisor_control_block54_*.py on the block 54 PR branch. TASK: (a) state and prove, at scope, a theorem of this form: for H_w = sqrt(w) H sqrt(w) on Z^3 with u = log w of gradient at most g and second differences at most g^2, and a positive-energy packet of wave vector k and width sigma with 1/k << sigma << 1/g, the mean position and the mean wave vector follow the rays of E = w(x) eps(k) for times T <= c/g with an explicit error bound in (1/(k sigma), g sigma, g T). Use only elementary operator estimates (commutators of H_w with X_j and with the translations; the exact identity of block 54 for uniform gradients is available as a lemma). (b) Identify the first correction beyond the rays: the projector on the positive-energy branch of h(k) = (sin k_1, sin k_2, sin k_3).sigma has a curvature Omega(k); compute it exactly on the lattice (not only at long wavelength, where it is k/(2|k|^3) up to sign), show that the packet's velocity acquires the term -(dk/dt) x Omega, and derive the sideways drift g T/(2k) with its sign and its dependence on the branch. (c) Say exactly which statement of universality survives: the fall along the gradient is the same for every packet; the sideways drift depends on the wave number and on the handedness of the walk. Is there a combination of the two branches, or of the eight zero-energy points k_j in {0, pi}, in which the sideways drifts cancel? check.py: numerical comparison with the block 54 controls at three wave vectors.  DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/ray-limit-of-the-clocked-walk/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py.
